About Kokonut

Built one idea
at a time.

Kokonut is a small, independent software studio in New Zealand.

I design, build and ship everything here myself, from the database schema to the last pixel. I’d rather make one thing properly than five things halfway.

Right now that one thing is Haste: a food journal fast enough that you’ll actually keep using it, and private enough that you can trust it.

Principles

What we won’t compromise.

Private by default

No ads, no trackers, no analytics on this site. Voice stays on the device. Data leaves your phone only when a feature needs it.

Fast is a feature

If logging a meal takes longer than eating it, people stop. Every screen is designed around the fewest taps.

Honest about what’s ready

Testing means testing. Estimates are shown as estimates. Nothing is promised before it works.
